import React, { useState } from 'react'; import DashboardLayout from '../../components/layout/DashboardLayout'; import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext'; import { getRequests } from '../../utils/storage'; import './StudentProfile.css'; const NAV_ITEMS = [ { path: '/student', label: 'Dashboard', icon: '🏠', end: true }, { path: '/student/submit', label: 'Submit Request', icon: '➕' }, { path: '/student/requests', label: 'My Requests', icon: '📋' }, { path: '/student/profile', label: 'Profile', icon: '👤' }, ]; export default function StudentProfile() { const { user } = useAuth(); const allRequests = getRequests(); const myRequests = allRequests.filter(r => r.studentId === user?.email); const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false); const stats = { total: myRequests.length, pending: myRequests.filter(r => r.status === 'Pending').length, resolved: myRequests.filter(r => r.status === 'Resolved').length, }; const handleSave = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); setSaved(true); setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000); }; return (
